listen_ip.description: IP address on which curvedns listens for incoming DNS queries (UDP/TCP).

listen_port.description: UDP/TCP port to listen on for incoming DNS queries (commonly 53 or 5353).

forward_host.description: Hostname or IP of the upstream recursive resolver (e.g., Unbound or systemd-resolved).

forward_port.description: Port of the upstream recursive resolver (usually 53).

dnscurve_mode.description: DNSCurve operation mode: disabled, server (respond to Curve clients), client ( Curve to upstream), or both.

dnscurve_public_key.description: DNSCurve public key (hex or PEM) for server mode. Leave empty to auto-generate (not safe for production).

dnscurve_secret_key.description: DNSCurve secret key (hex or PEM). Required for any active DNSCurve mode.

peers.description: List of authenticated DNSCurve peers (pre-shared keys).

public_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded 64-char public key of the peer (Curve25519).

secret_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded 64-char secret key (same key pair, or peer’s public + our secret).

role.description: Direction: how this peer interacts (client = sends to us, server = we query them).

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous connections (0 = no limit). Adjust for high-traffic deployments.

query_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for an upstream response before failing.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: 0=quiet, 5=debug. Set to 1–2 for normal operation.

chroot_path.description: Chroot directory for security hardening (empty = disabled).

run_user.description: User account under which curvedns runs (must exist).

run_group.description: Group for the curvedns process (must exist).

pidfile_path.description: Path to write the process PID file.

udp_forward.description: Enable forwarding of UDP queries to upstream resolver.

edns0.description: Enable EDNS0 support for upstream queries (e.g., for large DNSSEC responses).

upstream_allow.description: List of allowed IPs to which upstream recursion is permitted. Empty = allow all.

fallback_to_plain.description: If DNSCurve handshake fails with upstream, fall back to plain DNS (insecure but resilient).
